items.item_title: What types of carpentry services do you offer?
How do I request a quote or consultation?

settings.editor: We provide a full range of carpentry services including custom furniture, cabinetry, wood repairs, home renovations, deck building, and wood restorations.
You can easily request a free quote through our contact form or by calling us directly. Simply share your project details or photos, and we’ll provide an estimate within 24 hours.
Yes, we offer on-site assessments to measure, inspect, and discuss your needs in detail before starting the project. This helps ensure accurate pricing and perfect results.

items.item_title: How long does a custom project usually take?
